import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
customer_segments = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Convert categorical variables to categorical data type
customer_segments['Education'] = customer_segments['Education'].astype('category')
customer_segments['Marital_Status'] = customer_segments['Marital_Status'].astype('category')

# Map the categorical variables to integer values
education_map = customer_segments['Education'].cat.codes
marital_status_map = customer_segments['Marital_Status'].cat.codes

# Create a new dataframe with the mapped values
customer_segments['Education_Coded'] = education_map
customer_segments['Marital_Status_Coded'] = marital_status_map

# Plot the top 5 most frequent marital statuses by number of customers
top_marital_statuses = customer_segments['Marital_Status_Coded'].value_counts().head(5).reset_index()
top_marital_statuses.columns = ['Marital_Status', 'Count']

plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.barplot(x='Marital_Status', y='Count', data=top_marital_statuses)
plt.title('Top 5 Most Frequent Marital Statuses')
plt.xlabel('Marital Status')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.xticks(rotation=90)
plt.legend(title='Marital Status')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
